name: Buyer Merchandising Planning Report
query:
SELECT /* 1. STYLE IDENTIFICATION (Grid Layout) */ CONCAT( "", "", "", "
", "", "", "", ose.style_name, "", "", ose.buyer, " | ", ose.brand, "", "
" ) AS "Style & Buyer:Html:250", ose.gauge AS "GG:Data:45", ose.season AS "Season:Data:80", /* 2. ORDER QUANTITY & SHIPMENT */ ose.order_qty AS "Order Qty:Int:90", DATE_FORMAT(ose.shipment_date, "%%%%d-%%%%m-%%%%y") AS "Ship Date:Data:100", /* 3. PRODUCTION FLOW (Aggregated) */ IFNULL(prod.total_knit, 0) AS "Knit:Int:70", IFNULL(prod.total_link, 0) AS "Link:Int:70", IFNULL(prod.total_mending, 0) AS "Mend:Int:70", IFNULL(prod.total_wash, 0) AS "Wash:Int:70", IFNULL(prod.total_poly, 0) AS "Packed:Int:70", /* 4. YARN RECAP (From Subquery) */ CONCAT("
", "Req: ", ROUND(ose.total_required_yarn, 2), "
", "Status: ", CASE WHEN yrn.ready_lines = yrn.total_lines AND yrn.total_lines > 0 THEN "READY" WHEN yrn.ready_lines > 0 THEN "PARTIAL" ELSE "WAITING" END, "
") AS "Yarn Status:Html:130", /* 5. EXTRA PLANNING FIELDS */ ose.production_factory AS "Factory:Data:120", ose.production_status AS "Prod. Status:Data:100", ose.machine_type AS "M/C Type:Data:80", ose.machine_required AS "M/C Req:Int:70", ose.price AS "FOB:Currency:70", ose.l_c_number AS "L/C No:Data:100", ose.sdo_number AS "SDO:Data:80", ose.remarks AS "Remarks:Data:150" FROM `tabOrder Sheet Entry` ose /* JOIN 1: AGGREGATE PRODUCTION */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT parent, SUM(knit) as total_knit, SUM(link) as total_link, SUM(mending) as total_mending, SUM(wash) as total_wash, SUM(poly) as total_poly FROM `tabOrder Sheet Production` GROUP BY parent ) AS prod ON prod.parent = ose.name /* JOIN 2: AGGREGATE YARN DETAIL */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT parent, COUNT(*) as total_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN do_number IS NOT NULL AND do_number != "" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ready_lines FROM `tabOrder Sheet Yarn Detail` GROUP BY parent ) AS yrn ON yrn.parent = ose.name WHERE ose.docstatus < 2 AND (ose.buyer = %(buyer)s OR %(buyer)s IS NULL OR %(buyer)s = "") AND (ose.season = %(season)s OR %(season)s IS NULL OR %(season)s = "") ORDER BY ose.shipment_date ASC;
